title: All {count} Locations in Adopt Me
meta_description: Find permanent Adopt Me locations for shops, needs, jobs, eggs, trade licenses, Neon pets, and other Adoption Island services.
intro_md: Adoption Island locations turn pet needs and shopping plans into actual places to visit. Knowing which building handles each job saves time, especially when a Sick pet and a shopping list decide to arrive together.
description_md:
## Using Adoption Island landmarks

Treat the Nursery as a central anchor. The School sits opposite it, the Hospital is behind it, and the Pet Shop is to its left, which makes the middle of the island useful for eggs, training, healing, and pet shopping.

The Neighborhood tunnel and main bridge are the other strong landmarks. Coffee Shop, Ice Cream Shop, and Playground sit near the tunnel, while Neon Cave is underneath the bridge linking Adoption Island and the Neighborhood.

Sky Castle is the exception that prefers altitude over helpful street signs. Look above Adoption Island when you need its Potion shop.

## Completing needs and jobs

Go to the named need location when the matching task appears. Playground handles Bored, Hospital handles Sick, Campsite handles Camping, School handles School, and Beach Party handles its own outdoor need.

Pizza Shop and Salon combine needs with jobs. Pizza Shop also provides food, while Salon lets you work and change a pet's color, so both can solve more than one errand during the same visit.

## Using progression services

Nursery sells eggs and contains the VIP Room. Safety Hub provides the Trade License route and Code Redemption Kiosk, while Neon Cave is where fully grown pets are combined into Neon and Mega Neon pets.

These permanent locations stay separate from rotating weather shops, temporary maps, player houses, and the Neighborhood itself. That keeps route planning tied to the core island instead of sending you after a building that packed up with the forecast.
how_it_works_md: Type shows the location's main job. Map position gives a nearby landmark, Purpose explains what happens there, Connected need names any task it completes, and Shopkeeper identifies the supported NPC when one is present.

description_json.Shops: These permanent shops sell pet gear, food, vehicles, Potions, and other supplies on Adoption Island. Rotating weather shops are separate because their presence changes.
description_json.Need and Job Locations: Visit these places when the matching pet or baby need appears. Pizza Shop and Salon also offer jobs, so they can cover work and task progress in one stop.
description_json.Services and Progression: These locations handle eggs, trade access, code redemption, and Neon creation. They are progression stops rather than normal item shops.

faq_json.q: Where do I get a Trade License in Adopt Me?
faq_json.a: Go to the Safety Hub next to Green Groceries. It provides access to the Trade License route and the Code Redemption Kiosk.
Neon Cave is under the main bridge connecting Adoption Island and the Neighborhood. It is used to create Neon and Mega Neon pets.

faq_json.q: Which Adopt Me locations complete needs?
faq_json.a: Playground handles Bored, Hospital handles Sick, Campsite handles Camping, School handles School, and Beach Party handles its matching need. Pizza Shop and Salon also complete their named needs.

faq_json.q: Where can I work a job in Adopt Me?
faq_json.a: Pizza Shop and Salon offer jobs. They also support food, pet color changes, or matching needs depending on the location.
Visit Sky Castle above Adoption Island. Its main shop function is selling Potions.

faq_json.q: Are rotating weather shops permanent Adoption Island locations?
faq_json.a: No. Weather shops rotate with their weather systems, so they are separate from the permanent core-map locations.

wiki_md: Adoption Island locations handle shopping, pet and baby needs, jobs, eggs, trading access, and Neon creation. Use landmarks such as the Nursery, Neighborhood tunnel, and main bridge to plan quick routes between errands. Rotating weather shops and temporary maps sit outside the permanent island location system.
